name: Auburn
source:
MBTI: INTP

"But whatever this is, I don't really have the time to spare for it. So, as long as you're not dragging back my investigation of this place, I'm sure we won't have an issue."

The mature forensic investigator with an undying curiosity for finding clues. Auburn may struggle relating to peers his age, but his workaholic mindset definitely makes him one of the most productive investigators there is. Claiming his only plans were to work overnight until he eventually passed out, Auburn finds himself skeptical towards the situation and the other captives present. However, as long as people don't disturb his work, he'll be cooperating.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
